rows.observation: 1) "crush spellswords of all types with draconic might": spellswords are a type of combatant (warriors who use magic). The target "粉碎各种类型的魔法剑" mistranslates this as magic swords (weapons). 2) Hedges in the source are dropped, turning possibilities into certainties. "but it is possible that lesser uses of arcane magic do not have any inherent corrupting or harmful effect" becomes "本身并不会对世界带来任何腐蚀和有害的影响", which loses "it is possible that". "Maybe no Sun Paladin or Anorithil has yet sunk to the depths..." becomes "可以说…远远没有堕落到…", which changes "maybe not yet" into "far from". "some may enrich the lives" becomes "他们中的许多人，都可以", which turns "some may" into "many can". 3) "That said, this proves nothing about the most terrible potential of magic" becomes "同时，魔法仍然可能造成极其可怕的后果". This drops the argument that the evidence proves nothing.
